name: Kazuha Shizuka
source:
A girl who speaks in an ojou-sama (young lady) tone.
She has a strong-willed, pushy personality and a natural leader-like disposition.
Because of her forceful nature, she can come across as hard to approach,
but in reality, she cares about others more than anyone.

She tends to think things through carefully before acting, but her timing is often abrupt,
so she's frequently seen as eccentric or out of sync with those around her.

She absolutely loves eating, and mealtimes are always a source of happiness for her.
There's nothing she truly dislikes—she even finds joy in poorly made dishes, searching for little moments of happiness in them.
